question: Indicate which of the drugs listed below and used in the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension is NOT an analogue of prostacyclin:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Iloprost is a synthetic analogue of prostacyclin -> used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension -> not the answer -> 90%
CHAIN: Riociguat is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator -> not an analogue of prostacyclin -> used for pulmonary arterial hypertension -> 85%
CHAIN: Treprostinil is a synthetic analogue of prostacyclin -> used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension -> not the answer -> 90%
CHAIN: Epoprostenol is a naturally occurring prostacyclin analogue -> used for pulmonary arterial hypertension -> not the answer -> 90%
analysis: Riociguat is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator and does not act as a prostacyclin analogue, unlike Iloprost, Treprostinil, and Epoprostenol, which are all prostacyclin analogues used in the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension.
